title: Move Cohere chat and embed to the cohere-ruby 1.0 (v2 API) interface

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1068] Call the cohere-ruby 1.0 (v2 API) `chat` and `embed` from `Langchain::LLM::Cohere`, which raised `ArgumentError` with the gem version the gemspec requires; v1 `chat_history` messages are converted, and `CohereResponse` reads v2 and v1 bodies.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1065] Leave the tools out of the request when the Ollama assistant adapter gets `tool_choice: "none"`, and stop logging `tool_choice`/`parallel_tool_calls` warnings on every call for the Assistant's defaults.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1063] Send `tool_choice: "auto"` from `Langchain::Assistant` once a forced tool (`"any"` or a function name) has been called since the latest user message, so a run with a forced tool can finish instead of calling the tool until `max_turns`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1064] Send `tool_choice: "none"` as the string `"none"` from the OpenAI and Mistral AI assistant adapters instead of a function named `none`, which the APIs rejected.

@@ -98,9 +99,11 @@ def chat(params = {})
 
       parameters = chat_parameters.to_params(params)
 
-      # Cohere API requires `message:` parameter to be sent separately from `chat_history:`.
-      # We extract the last message from the messages param.
-      parameters[:message] = parameters[:chat_history].pop&.dig(:message)
+      # The v2 Chat API takes the system prompt as the first message.
+      messages = Array(parameters[:messages]).map { |message| v2_message(message) }
+      system = parameters.delete(:system)
+      messages.unshift({role: "system", content: system}) if system
+      parameters[:messages] = messages
 
       response = client.chat(**parameters)
 
@@ -117,5 +120,19 @@ def summarize(text:)
       response = client.summarize(text: text)
       response.dig("summary")
     end
+
+    private
+
+    V1_ROLES = {"USER" => "user", "CHATBOT" => "assistant", "SYSTEM" => "system"}.freeze
+
+    # Converts a v1 chat_history entry ({role: "USER", message: "..."}) to a v2 message
+    # ({role: "user", content: "..."}); v2 messages are returned unchanged.
+    def v2_message(message)
+      message = message.transform_keys(&:to_sym)
+      return message unless message.key?(:message)
+
+      role = message[:role].to_s
+      {role: V1_ROLES.fetch(role.upcase, role.downcase), content: message[:message]}
+    end
   end
 end

@@ -6,8 +6,10 @@ def embedding
       embeddings.first
     end
 
+    # The v2 Embed API returns {"float" => [[...]]}, the v1 API a plain array.
     def embeddings
-      raw_response.dig("embeddings")
+      embeddings = raw_response.dig("embeddings")
+      embeddings.is_a?(Hash) ? embeddings["float"] : embeddings
     end
 
     def completions
@@ -19,19 +21,38 @@ def completion
     end
 
     def chat_completion
-      raw_response.dig("text")
+      content = message&.dig("content")
+      return raw_response.dig("text") unless content
+
+      content.select { |block| block["type"] == "text" }.map { |block| block["text"] }.join
     end
 
     def role
-      raw_response.dig("chat_history").last["role"]
+      message&.dig("role") || raw_response.dig("chat_history")&.last&.dig("role")
+    end
+
+    def tool_calls
+      message&.dig("tool_calls") || []
     end
 
     def prompt_tokens
-      raw_response.dig("meta", "billed_units", "input_tokens")
+      billed_units&.dig("input_tokens")
     end
 
     def completion_tokens
-      raw_response.dig("meta", "billed_units", "output_tokens")
+      billed_units&.dig("output_tokens")
+    end
+
+    private
+
+    # The v2 Chat API returns the reply as a "message" hash; an error body has a "message" string.
+    def message
+      raw_response["message"] if raw_response["message"].is_a?(Hash)
+    end
+
+    # v2 responses report usage under "usage", v1 responses under "meta".
+    def billed_units
+      raw_response.dig("usage", "billed_units") || raw_response.dig("meta", "billed_units")
     end
   end
 end
